# Responsive token matrix

Responsive behavior in this system uses **three deliberate mechanisms**; everything else is static.

| Mechanism | Used for | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **Fluid** (`clamp()`) | The 9 scaled type sizes; section spacing | Continuous growth between phone and wide desktop, no media-query overrides, proportions preserved. Spacing is fluid only for section rhythm; type below 16px is never fluid; body, label and input text are fixed |
| **Tier** (3 media-query steps) | Gutter, grid gap, product columns, header height, drawer width, card padding | Only values that must change together with a layout change at a breakpoint; each has a stated reason |
| **Static** | Colors, the spacing scale, radii, shadows, touch target, body and input text, most component sizes | Nothing gained by changing them per viewport |

## Tier tokens

Every token whose value changes by tier. Mobile-first: the **mobile** value is the base; tablet and desktop override it with `min-width` media queries.

| Tier | Applies | Media query |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile | 0 - 599px (base) | none |
| Tablet | 600px - 1023px | `@media (min-width: 37.5rem)` |
| Desktop | 1024px and up | `@media (min-width: 64rem)` |

Alias values show the token they point to and the resolved size. 1rem = 16px. Cells marked with the same value across tiers are explicit by design (so the intent is documented), but only genuine changes are emitted as overrides in the CSS.

**14 tier tokens**, **0 fluid tokens** and **327 static tokens** (see [Documentation/token-reference.md](Documentation/token-reference.md)).

## Fluid tokens (`clamp()`)

Each value grows linearly with the viewport between two widths and is held at its minimum below and its maximum above. Pixel sizes are computed from the actual expression at 1rem = 16px.

| Token | Min | Max | Fluid between | 360px | 600px | 768px | 1024px | 1280px | 1440px | 1920px | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Behavior that changes by tier (not expressible as a token)

These are documented rules, implemented by components/templates in later phases, using the tokens above.

| Topic | Mobile | Tablet | Desktop |
|---|---|---|---|
| Navigation | Icon buttons + drawer menu | Icon buttons + drawer menu | Inline links |
| Primary button width | Full width (`.btn--block-mobile`) | Natural width | Natural width |
| Forms | Single column | Two columns where fields pair naturally | Two columns, `--container-narrow` cap |
| Product gallery | Swipeable carousel, full-bleed | Carousel + thumbnails | Thumbnails + large image, split with details |
| Filters | Drawer | Drawer | Sidebar |
| Filter drawer presentation | Full-width sheet (--layout-drawer-width: 100%) | 26rem side panel | 26rem side panel (a sidebar is a later page-layout decision) |
| Collection paging | **Load more** (provisional: nothing verified against Shopify) | Numbered pagination | Numbered pagination |
| Breadcrumb | One line: parent and current page (current truncates) | Full trail, wraps | Full trail, wraps |
| Filter chip row (choices) | One horizontally scrolling line | Wraps | Wraps (applied filters wrap at every size) |
| Product card quick-add | Always visible | Always visible | Always visible; hover adds image zoom only |
| Touch targets | >= 44px | >= 44px | >= 44px (the small button and chip keep a 40px visual and a 44px hit area) |
| Body text | 16px | 16px | 16px (never smaller) |
